summary: Active Japanese centralized crypto-asset lending service currently operated by SBI Digital Finance Inc. Customers lend crypto assets to the operator under a lending / quasi-consumption-loan structure and receive lending fees according to published conditions.
what_happened: HashHub Lending remains active under SBIデジタルファイナンス株式会社. On 2024-04-01, a company split transferred the HashHub Lending service and related contractual rights and obligations from 株式会社HashHub to the newly established SBIデジタルファイナンス株式会社. Current first-party materials describe customer assets as borrowed by the operator and potentially deployed through arbitrage, third-party lending, staking and DeFi. In 2026, new DAI lending intake ended on 2026-05-20 and DAI lending-fee accrual stopped from 2026-07-01, while BTC, ETH, USDC, XRP and SOL lending remained advertised. Published rates, security language and deployment descriptions are issuer claims, not independent evidence of realized returns, reserves, guarantees or solvency.
uncertainty_notes: The reviewed first-party material does not establish a sufficiently reliable exact original launch day, so launch_date remains unset. Current lending-fee rates, security/risk-management statements, asset-deployment descriptions and legal/regulatory characterizations remain issuer statements and may change. The operator-transition event is exact to 2024-04-01 from first-party company-split documentation.
notes: Promoted in Phase 10 from duplicate-clear candidate cya_candidate_000124 after candidate-only PR #215 passed the hardened full-corpus scanner with one draft-eligible candidate.
